theorems.name: Submission.dor_lmbsf_cp_chart_tangent_ae
theorems.statement: (∀ (P n : ℕ) (U A B : Set (Euclid P)), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet A → MeasurableSet B → A ⊆ B → B ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[n] (B ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[n].restrict A), ∀ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P), HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n B x Q ↔ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt n A x Q) → ∀ (P m : ℕ) (U M : Set (Euclid P)) (C C' : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P), IsOpen U → MeasurableSet M → M ⊆ U → (∀ K : Set (Euclid P), IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → μHE[m] (M ∩ K) ≠ ∞) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ C' → ψ '' C' ⊆ U → IsCompact C → IsCompact C' → Convex ℝ C' → C ⊆ interior C' → (∀ y ∈ interior C', HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m (ψ '' C') (ψ y) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))) → ∀ᵐ x ∂(μHE[m].restrict (M ∩ ψ '' C)), ∀ y ∈ C, ψ y = x → HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m M x (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ y : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
